title: ApiIndex
description: api-index@1 (02 §7, ADR 0013): api/v1/index.json, the agent API's mutable entry point. API and schema versions, repository, generation and the streams with their latest runs. No URLs: paths are fixed by the API version.

versions.description: Separate version numbers: the PixelWatch release that built the site, the API, and each served document's schema.

streams.description: main first, then pull requests by number: main plus at most 1000 PR streams (config@1 retention.prStreams). Empty streams aren't listed.
